PostToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.py$'; then uv run ruff check --fix "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | tail -10; uv run ruff format "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | tail -5; fi
PostToolUse.description: Python 改动自动 ruff fix + format (CI 跑 format --check 会因此挂)

PreToolUse.command: case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_BASH_COMMAND" in *'git push'*|*'--no-verify'*|*'reset --hard'*|*'rm -rf /'*) echo 'BLOCKED: 需要用户明确授权' >&2; exit 2;; esac
